issues.description: Global entry symbol (program entry visibility) is inconsistent: template_repository/pixel.asm declares the entry symbol with 'global main' (template_repository/pixel.asm: line 30), while solution_repository/pixel.asm declares 'global _start' (solution_repository/pixel.asm: line 14) even though the solution still defines a 'main' label (solution_repository/pixel.asm: line 36). The template Makefile assembles and links the object with gcc (template_repository/Makefile: lines 6-8), which typically expects a conventional 'main' symbol provided to the C runtime. This mismatch can confuse students which symbol to provide as the program entry point and how the program is linked/run.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the entry symbol consistent across template and solution. Preferred: change the solution's directive to 'global main' (replace 'global _start' with 'global main' in solution_repository/pixel.asm) so both template and solution use the same entry symbol and match the Makefile's linking. Alternatively, if the intent is to use a raw '_start' entry, update the template and Makefile to document and expect '_start' (and ensure linking omits or adjusts the C runtime accordingly).

issues.description: Program entry symbol naming is inconsistent across artifacts. The template exports the symbol 'main' (declaration: 'global main' in template/pixel.asm) and defines the label 'main' (label 'main:' in template/pixel.asm). The solution exports the symbol '_start' (declaration: 'global _start' in solution/pixel.asm) but defines the label 'main' (label 'main:' in solution/pixel.asm). Students comparing template and solution or attempting to assemble/link may be confused which symbol is intended as the program entry point and may encounter linker/runtime issues because the exported global and the defined label do not match.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the program entry symbol consistent. Option A (minimal): change the solution's declaration 'global _start' to 'global main' so the exported symbol matches the defined 'main' label in solution/pixel.asm. Option B (explicit): change the template to export/define '_start' (replace 'global main' with 'global _start' and rename the 'main:' label to '_start:') and update the build/link approach if necessary. Prefer Option A to align with the existing template and gcc linking expectations.
